title: Tia | Changing a record owner by user name fails with "RECORD_VALIDATION_FAILED"
summary: When asked to change the owner of a record to a named user, Tia puts the user name into the card instead of the user. Confirming the card fails, and the owner does not change.
steps: Sign in to CRM as the Owner and open Tia.
Send: Change the owner of the lead named "<lead>" to the user <user name>. Prepare the card for me to confirm.
Press Confirm on the card.
expected: The card names the user (resolved from the name) and Confirm changes the owner; the new owner gets the "You've been assigned" notification.
actual: The card shows "owner: <user name>". Confirm returns: "This was refused: The app refused this request (RECORD_VALIDATION_FAILED)." The owner is unchanged.
more: When the raw user id is given instead of the name, the same card works and the new owner gets the same notification as for a manual change.
Users will always ask by name, so owner changes through Tia do not work in practice.

title: Tia | "Starts with" record counts are wrong: Tia says there are none when there are many
summary: Plain counts are right, but counts with a "first name starts with" condition are sometimes reported as zero.
steps: As the Owner in CRM, ask Tia: How many leads have a first name starting with "Name"?
As a CRM Manager user, ask: How many leads have a first name starting with "QA"?
Compare with the leads list filtered the same way.
expected: Tia gives the same number as the filtered list (1,000 for the Owner; 4 for the Manager user).
actual: Both times Tia replied that there are no such leads. For the Owner, the "QA" prefix gave the right number (10).
more: Benchmark on 26 Nov: 25 of 27 count questions were right (CRM, Desk, Arabic); both misses are "starts with" filters.

title: Tia | Custom actions: Tia lists only some actions, shows an internal error, and looks for a module instead of running the action
summary: 10 custom actions are marked for AI use, but Tia offers only 3, and simple requests to run an action fail in different ways.
steps: As the Owner in CRM, ask Tia: Which actions can you run for me? List them by name.
Ask: Run the NDC wallet balance action for me. Prepare the card for me to confirm.
Ask: Look up booking QATEST1 using the Look up booking action. Prepare the card for me to confirm.
Ask: Search flights from Cairo to Dubai on 2026-12-20 for 1 adult. Prepare the card for me to confirm.
expected: Tia lists every action that is turned on for AI and prepares a run card for each request.
actual: Step 1 lists 3 actions (Look up booking, NDC login (token), NDC Portal bot · look up booking) out of 10 AI-enabled. Step 2 answers with an internal error: "Missing valid UUID for 'action_id'. Cannot correct without the exact UUID from the list." Step 3 answers "I could not find a module named 'booking'". Step 4 is refused as off-topic: "Sorry, I'm not able to help with that topic here."
more: Only when the exact action name and input are given ("Run the custom action named \"Look up booking\" with pnrOrReference = QATEST1") does Tia prepare a run card.
Actions not marked for AI (void, pay, book) were correctly refused, but Tia's reply wrongly says "I do not have the ability to prepare cards for confirmation".

title: Tia | A custom action confirmed through Tia says "may or may not have gone through" and does not appear in the run history
summary: After confirming a run card, the user cannot tell whether the action ran, and the run is not recorded.
steps: As the Owner in CRM, ask Tia: Run the custom action named "Look up booking" with pnrOrReference = QATEST1.
Press Confirm on the card.
Open the custom action run history.
expected: The card shows the action's result (or its error, for example that the booking was not found or sign-in is needed), and the run appears in the run history.
actual: Confirm returns status "unknown": "The app didn't confirm this, so it may or may not have gone through. Please check before trying again." No new run appears in the custom action run history.
more: Only a read-only lookup with a made-up reference was confirmed; no write action was run.
The card did not ask for the action's required Authorization input.

title: Tia | Observability shows only 21.6% of Tia's tool calls succeed
summary: The agent metrics for Tia over the last 30 days report a tool success rate of 0.216, so about 4 in 5 tool calls fail.
steps: As the Owner, open Tia's Observability metrics (GET /agents/{tia id}/metrics).
expected: Most tool calls succeed; failures are rare and explained.
more: This matches answers seen in testing where Tia shows internal tool errors (NDC-3346, the custom action error above) or gives up with "I can't confirm that from our systems right now" (NDC-3350).
Part of the failures may be expected refusals (no access), but the figure should be checked and broken down by tool.

title: Tia | Small issues: stopped answers are charged, a second tab is "busy", report runs give no total, "this list" has no count, wrong record type and wrong card claim
summary: Several small problems found while testing on 26 Nov. Each can be split into its own ticket if needed.
steps: Stop an answer while Tia is writing it (Stop button / cancel the turn) and compare the AI credits before and after.
Open Tia in two tabs and send a message in each at the same time.
Ask Tia to run the report "test" and tell the total number of rows.
Open the Leads list, open Tia and ask: How many records are in this list?
Open a lead and ask Tia: Summarise this record.
Ask Tia: Void the tickets for booking reference QATEST1. Prepare the card for me to confirm.
expected: 1: a stopped answer is not charged, or the charge is shown. 2: both chats answer (or the second waits). 3: Tia gives the total. 4: Tia counts the list. 5: Tia calls it a lead. 6: Tia says this action is not available to it.
actual: 1: the stopped answer used 213 units. 2: the second message gets TIA_BUSY even though it is a different chat. 3: "The report shows at least 17 rows, with more rows available" (no total). 4: "I do not have the exact count of records in this list available right now." 5: "This record is for a contact named 'test'" on a lead. 6: "I do not have the ability to prepare cards for confirmation" (Tia does prepare cards).
